title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED Broadway Show in Springfield, MO – Jan 2027
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical about Maizy and Beau, whose wedding plans collide with the dying corn that protects their small community of Cob County, and the songs include 'Woman of the World', 'Somebody Will' and 'Independently Owned'. It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, adult language and corny innuendo. Performances run January 19 through 21, 2027, at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
